root_cause: powerhouse_prepare_connection_activation_v1 chooses linkedin_dm whenever a LinkedIn URL exists, which is every connection. linkedin_dm has no automated executor and needs human approval, so the 10 daily actions expired (70 in 7 days) and email was never chosen: autonomous outreach reported NO_ELIGIBLE_PREPARED_EMAIL.
fix: Prepare up to 5 autonomous_email actions per day for approved-email connections from the existing daily activation job; keep every send gate unchanged.
prevention_rule: A prepared action must target a channel that has an executor. A channel without an executor is a gap to report, not a default.
terminal_rule: Merged main, migration applied, next daily activation run prepares autonomous_email actions, composer passes quality, powerhouse-autonomous-outreach sends with provider readback or reports the exact held reason.
